items.title: These 3 Boring Stocks Have One Thing in Common: Demand That Cannot Wait
items.summary: A busted furnace in January or a cracked water main under Main Street share something important: neither waits for the economy to cooperate. Three under-the-radar distributors built their businesses around exactly that pressure, and their financials tell a story most investors overlook.
